system.description:
You have 10 [Inventory Slots]. Items in the [Inventory Slots] gained from this item are not affected by the "Consumption Table". [Trigger: Pre-Play] You obtain one "Healing Potion (any grade)" of an Item Rank you can use or lower. Locking Strap Bag A shoulder bag whose mouth cannot open unless the owner speaks a specific password. It has a vault-like property that prevents its contents from being stolen even if the owner dies or is incapacitated, making it a favorite among merchants.

Magic Lock [Core Material] (180G) + Waterproof Bag (70G) + Potion Holder (Intermediate) (240G) + [Magic Catalyst 10] (110G) ×3 + Crafting Cost (300G)
